name: Sim800L → On Dtmf Received
description:
An action to be performed when a DTMF key is pressed by the other party during a call. See [`on_dtmf_received` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l/#on_dtmf_received-trigger).

This automation triggers every time the other party presses a key on their phone keypad during a connected call. The pressed key is available in the lambda as a `key` string parameter, holding one of `0`-`9`, `*`, `#` or `A`-`D`. Each key press triggers the automation once.
